clearAllDataConfirm: Clear everything? This cannot be undone.
clearAllDataDescription: Chats, files and settings on this device. Wallets stay.
clearAllDataInfo: Wallets are not deleted: spend or back up your sats first if you want them gone too.

cues.connectionHint: Invite used, transport change, back online

defaultNicknameHint: Used when you start a new chat
deleteAllChatsHint: Messages and files go. Settings and wallets stay.
linkPreviewsHint: Send a title and picture with the links you share
linkPreviewsInfo: This device reads the page and sends the preview with the message, so your contact's app never contacts the site. Off: links go as plain text.
lockScreenDescription: Asks for a password after inactivity. Does not encrypt stored chats.

media.cameraInfo: Used for calls and photos. Kept on this device, for this profile.
media.failed: Could not open it. Check that Ghostly may use it.
media.microphoneInfo: Used for calls and voice messages. Kept on this device, for this profile. When it is unplugged, Ghostly uses the system default.
media.missing: {{name}} is not connected. Using the default.
media.namesHint: Allow the microphone and camera to see them
media.speaker: Speaker
media.speakerInfo: Where calls, voice messages, videos and sounds play. Kept on this device, for this profile.
media.title: Audio & video

noticesDenied: Blocked. Allow them in device or browser settings.
noticesDeniedMac: Allow them in macOS Settings → Notifications → Ghostly
noticesDeniedWindows: Allow them in Windows Settings → Notifications
noticesMisplaced: Move Ghostly to Applications to allow them
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 4 characters
profileLinkHint: Name, picture, backups and other profiles
profilePeekHint: Show when a message waits for another profile
profilePeekInfo: Now and then this app reads what your other unlocked profiles' contacts publish for them, over the same relays or DHT those profiles use. It only reads: it never opens a message, and locked profiles are skipped.
profilePeekNotifyHint: A system notice when one gets a message
publicProfilesHint: Pictures and bios on identity cards. Those servers see your IP.
publicProfilesInfo: When a verified Nostr, Pubky or Bluesky identity is on screen, its card reads the picture, name, bio and followers from that network (your Nostr relays, nexus.pubky.app, public.api.bsky.app). Those servers see your IP address and which identity was looked at. Off: cards show only what the proof carries, and what was loaded is deleted.
reduceMotionHint: Fewer animations. Your system setting always applies.
sendTypingHint: Contacts see when you're writing. Off, you still see theirs.
shareProfile: Share my name and picture with contacts
shareProfileHint: Your contacts see this profile's name and picture. Off, they see “Contact” and a pattern instead.
title: Settings
